decision_basis: Each title and complete abstract was read together; admission requires a durable AI-System mechanism, ownership, or evaluation-contract delta.

rows.reason: The paper makes the separation between model inference, orchestration, memory, planning, and action execution its central architectural claim and tests an integrated OpenClaw/Ollama stack; that is a candidate Agent-platform responsibility boundary rather than mere agent terminology.

The intervention studies teacher scaffolding and discourse changes among 78 preparatory students; it does not change a reusable model, runtime, state, control, release, or evaluation contract for an AI system.

The work defines a repeatable evaluation protocol for autonomous research systems and exposes material disagreement among model judges, so evaluator identity and synthesis are part of the evidence contract that a platform must preserve.

The three-stage conjecture-generation pipeline is scoped to mathematical problem discovery, and Lean parsing plus failure of two tactics does not establish a broader agent workflow or platform validation boundary.

Topology discovery, per-transfer transport selection, layer-pipelined KV movement, MoE-aware placement, and a CXL overflow tier jointly move data and placement ownership across prefill/decode pools; the projection-only evaluation is a boundary to review, not a reason to discard the mechanism.

This is an education-assessment study comparing item-difficulty predictors; its failure analysis concerns a specific testing task and does not revise a general AI-system evaluation or deployment contract.

GMM-guided LLM text augmentation improves minority-topic clustering in several datasets, but the abstract offers a localized data-method result without changing training-data provenance, lifecycle ownership, or a platform interface.

The finding that audit effectiveness depends on both auditor family and bias type, plus a calibration/test selector, changes how an LLM-judge pipeline must bind evaluator identity and calibration evidence.

The two-stage LoRA/contrastive ensemble is a task-specific Nepali meme-classification entry; placement and training choices remain local to that shared task and do not establish a durable multimodal or training-system boundary.

State-grounded predictive assessments replace trajectory-level hindsight and become explicit reusable agent state learned by distillation or RL; that is a concrete change to memory representation and policy consumption across episodes.

The study shows that aggregate bias metrics hide movement between abstention, committed answers, and capability loss, and proposes a three-part calibration diagnosis; this is a durable evaluation-contract correction rather than a single quality score.

TokenSwap constructs semantically matched text and image-interleaved inputs and measures a modality-equivalence gap across 42 models, giving the multimodal evaluation layer an explicit cross-modality invariance contract.

The paper claims that judge systems can mistake procedural consensus for truth and that swarm topology changes the resulting blind spot; despite the strong abstract language, this is a testable evaluator-capture and topology-dependent evidence-boundary claim.

Interface writeback and reset turn discarded reasoning history into an explicit continuation state under a bounded context window, separating intermediate-state commit from final-answer reward and changing long-horizon context control.

The contribution is a corpus and behavioral study of when humans or models intervene in online discussions; it does not define a durable agent-runtime or platform control mechanism beyond this facilitation domain.
Persona-conditioned creativity scoring and CLIP probes describe perspective-dependent interpretation of artworks, not a reusable ownership or evaluation contract for the book's AI-system lifecycle.

MobileForge expands design-to-code evaluation from isolated screens to buildable multi-page projects and makes navigation isolation, project maintainability, and visual-judge anchoring first-class test contracts.

The narrative analysis of affirmative chatbot behavior is socially important context, but the abstract does not expose a system mechanism, enforceable safety control, or reproducible release/evaluation interface to admit.

ConnectED integrates training and teacher gates for Vietnamese lesson planning, yet the described lifecycle is tied to one curriculum and user study and does not establish a transferable platform responsibility boundary.

PRISM targets appraisal-dimension inference in emotional-support conversations; its Bayesian multi-agent formulation remains a domain task method and does not alter a general multi-agent state or control contract.
